authority.scope: GTK2 partial repaint investigation only; no installed theme changes.

findings.r527_reconciliation: The vertical corruption at (0,0) missed the stepper. GtkRange has no own GdkWindow in this probe and shares the top-level window; the actual vertical stepper is at (92,22). For this no-window widget, queue_draw_area must use shared-window coordinates. The previous R527 vertical pixel result was invalid.
findings.baseline_partial_expose: With R525 geometry, GTK emits an expose for a 1x1 damage at the outer 2px of the reconstructed 15x15 asset, but GtkRange does not invoke the stepper draw callback because its declared area is 15x11 horizontally / 11x15 vertically. Damage within the declared area does invoke the callback.
findings.property_alternatives: trough-under-steppers=0 yields full 15x15 callbacks and repairs partial damage, but shifts cell positions by 2px; this remains rejected in the installed rendering by R327-R329. A private stepper-size=19 variant keeps the 15x15 asset inside a 19x15/15x19 draw area and repaints, but in a 542px horizontal test its right cell lands at x=525 while SR10.4 is x=526 (72/225 differences at the reference crop). Neither variant is selected.
findings.after_expose_harness: An after-expose handler in a separate private GTK2 harness redrew only the damaged intersection of the cached 15x15 stepper cell. Horizontal-left overscan and vertical-up overscan each changed by 1 pixel when damaged and returned to 0/225 difference from the initial cell after repaint. The original 15x15 geometry/asset placement was preserved.

limits: The after-expose repair is an external test harness callback, not integrated into the theme engine.
Only two normal-state overscan points were damaged; four directions, end cells, endpoint/pressed/hover/disabled states and resize remain untested.
Cached state handling, signal lifetime and interaction with GTK2's native repaint path must be proven in a private engine before any package change.
This does not constitute a fresh VM comparison or visual acceptance.
next: Prototype the post-expose handler inside a private GTK2 style engine with per-widget cell geometry and current state derived from the range/palette. Verify all four directions, each affected state, endpoint input blocking, resize and exact 1:1 cell pixels before considering integration. Keep the installed theme unchanged.
